channel.title: Pier & Point · Sister Lillian Murphy Community
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Sister Lillian Murphy Community (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8711020 lists the address 671-691 China Basin St. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8711020.

item.title: Correction · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: An April 5, 2022 SF YIMBY article says the City and…
item.description: An April 5, 2022 SF YIMBY article says the City and Mayor Breed were celebrating the inauguration of the development; it gives no event date. DBI recorded the building permit complete on 2021-10-20, a permit closeout date, not an occupancy date. Source: https://sfyimby.com/2022/04/our-city-mayor-london-breed-celebrate-new-housing-at-691-china-basin-street-mission-bay-san-francisco.html ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201804196818.

item.title: Correction · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: The only dated source read is SF YIMBY's article…
item.description: The only dated source read is SF YIMBY's article published April 5, 2022, which reports the City and the Mayor celebrating the new housing; it does not give the date of the event, and no opening date is confirmed. Source: SF YIMBY, 2022-04-05 (sfyimby.com/2022/04/our-city-mayor-london-breed-celebrate-new-housing-at-691-china-basin-street-mission-bay-san-francisco.html).

item.title: Correction · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: The map notes gave the parcel as 7,363 sq m and the…
item.description: The map notes gave the parcel as 7,363 sq m and the footprint union as 892 sq m; both are Web Mercator areas, and the true figures are about 4,590 and 556 sq m, so a dated correction was added. The summary no longer says Sister Lillian Murphy founded Mercy Housing or belonged to the Sisters of Mercy (SF YIMBY says she led Mercy Housing for 27 years), names the developer as Mercy Housing as the article does, and cites DataSF Parcels for the 671-691 address range. The permit quotation is now verbatim, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: SF YIMBY, 2022-04-05 (https://sfyimby.com/2022/04/our-city-mayor-london-breed-celebrate-new-housing-at-691-china-basin-street-mission-bay-san-francisco.html); DataSF Parcels, blklot 8711020 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8711020); DataSF Building Permits, permit #201804196818 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201804196818); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Milestone · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: SF YIMBY (article dated April 5, 2022)… (~Apr 2022)
item.description: SF YIMBY (article dated April 5, 2022) reports the City and Mayor London Breed 'celebrating the inauguration of a new housing develoment' at 691 China Basin Street; the article gives no event date and still says the development 'will bring 152 units'. (~Apr 2022). Source: San Francisco YIMBY, 2022-04.

item.title: Complete · Sister Lillian Murphy Community: DBI records new-construction permit… (Oct 20, 2021)
item.description: DBI records new-construction permit 201804196818 (691 China Basin St, 7 stories, 152 dwelling units) as complete. A permit's completion date is not an occupancy or opening date. (Oct 20, 2021). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection.
